items.source: This is an alternative to a full ConfigurableBeanFactory dependency via the ApplicationContextAware/BeanFactoryAware interfaces.
items.translation: 这是通过 `ApplicationContextAware`/`BeanFactoryAware` 接口依赖完整 `ConfigurableBeanFactory` 的替代方案。
